title: Application Form By A Co Operative Society For Licence To Commence Banking Business As A Central Co Operative Bank
description: A application form by a co operative society for licence to commence banking business as a central co operative bank used for conveyance, transfer, or agreements related to property and assets. Suitable for buyers, sellers, donors, donees, or parties to property transactions. Key details required: Signatory Name.
description_hi: Application Form By A Co Operative Society For Licence To Commence Banking Business As A Central Co Operative Bank — संपत्ति और परिसंपत्तियों से संबंधित हस्तांतरण या समझौते के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। खरीदार, विक्रेता, दानकर्ता, प्रतिग्रहीता, या संपत्ति लेनदेन के पक्ष के लिए उपयुक्त। 1 आवश्यक विवरण भरने होंगे।
